reason: The Grok ACP harness broke several Agent Client Protocol rules. After Stop it dropped the cancelled session/prompt and sent the next prompt at once, so late updates from the stopped turn became part of the next answer (HARN-5); it never answered a pending session/request_permission on Stop (HARN-6) or any other agent request such as fs/*, terminal/* or _x.ai/* (HARN-7), which hangs the turn; max_tokens, max_turn_requests and refusal were saved as clean verified completions (HARN-8); one-time decisions were sent as allow_always/reject_always (HARN-11); non-text content chunks were dropped (HARN-13); ACP messageId was ignored so replays doubled the answer (HARN-14); usage_update became a notice (HARN-15); and session/load was sent without checking agentCapabilities.loadSession. GrokAcpConnection now keeps the prompt task and waits (bounded) for the stopped prompt's answer, tracks and answers open permission requests with cancelled, answers unknown requests with -32601 in and between turns, marks truncations incomplete and refusals as errors, picks *_once options by exact kind, renders non-text blocks, groups messages by messageId, maps usage_update to detailed usage with a measured per-turn cost, and GrokAcpAdapter._open checks loadSession. tests/v3/test_grok_acp_compliance.py drives the real GrokAcpAdapter/_AcpRpc against a scripted ACP agent subprocess that logs every frame (plus in-memory and HarnessRuntimeService tests); all 22 fail on main. The selected existing tests cover the Grok fixture edited for loadSession, the #476 replay case, commentary splitting, the result-text fallback, the permission handoff receipt and connection construction.
exclusions: No frontend tests: no ui/ change. No native tests: no Tauri or Rust change. No Playwright: area:core-api (the real-Core journey suite) has no Grok ACP agent and does not exercise the Grok connection; the Python tests drive the real adapter over a scripted ACP subprocess. Whole existing files (test_harnesses.py, test_harness_adapters.py, test_harness_commands.py, test_approval_handoff.py, test_harness_connection_state.py, test_harness_provider_subagents.py) were run locally (250 passed) and are not selected, per CI scoping. No full suites.
